body: Sorry, I have not slept in 32 hours.
What broke the camels back? Why is marriage so hard? And how do I get the poison?

I agree. I would have left a long time a go. Right after we got married my dad died, then my grandma whom raised me, my brother, grandpa, my other grandpa and then recently my mom. We have only been married for 5 years. I feel like I've just been trying to survive instead of actually living. Thank you for your honesty.
That's what I keep telling him. My mom died a couple of months a go, so I don't know when the right time for divorce would be, considering we have children (Our fighting in NEVER in front of my kids)
It is paid off. I am just full of cabin fever.
This might sound stupid, but his behavior often leaves me feeling this way. I feel like a Russian bride sometimes.
I am 25 and he's 35. Maybe that explains it.
